approval.scope: Bounded candidate2 integration, preserving historical roster scope; no turnover-weight search or automatic release.

unchanged: all player identities and peak years
all approved roster bands and variants
live rules and saves until explicit release acceptance
stages: Freeze and validate the single missing-turnover policy using observed modern peaks with masked labels. Save training/calibration evidence before opening evaluation labels. Failure stops integration.

If the masking gate passes, emit a separate historical modeled-input layer with provenance and uncertainty, preserving raw nulls. Treat cross-era transport as an assumption, not validated historical truth.

Before any new roster outcomes, freeze one complete-strength mapping using candidate2 costs, existing offense inputs and existing defensive/coach/reserve rules. No parameter search. Require all exposed roster bands and mandatory variants to pass, with missing-data sensitivity retained. Failure stops this cycle.
Only a complete passing finalist may proceed to separately user-approved fresh families and the existing policy/player/engineering gates. No silent scope narrowing or fresh-panel reuse.

missingDataPolicy.name: masked-peak-neighbors-1
missingDataPolicy.identityPartition: SHA256 of underlying player id, interpreted as a big-endian integer modulo10: 0-5 donor, 6-7 calibration, 8-9 evaluation. Every version of an identity stays in its partition.
missingDataPolicy.donors: Complete observed peaks with every selected season from1978 through2002, donor identities only. One version per identity: greatest total observed minutes, tie lexicographic version id. Population mean and standard deviation of donor features only.
missingDataPolicy.calibration: Complete observed peaks with every selected season from2003 through2012, calibration identities only. One version per identity by greatest total minutes then version id. No calibration labels enter point predictions.
missingDataPolicy.evaluation: Complete observed peaks with every selected season from2013 through2026, evaluation identities only. One version per identity by greatest total minutes then version id. Save donor/calibration artifact before predicting evaluation rows.
missingDataPolicy.estimator: Mean turnoversPer36 of the50 nearest donors by squared Euclidean distance on donor-standardized shotEndsPer36 and assistsPer36. Tie by donor id. Exactly50 donors required; no bandwidth, feature or neighbor-count search. Constant donor target mean is the baseline.
missingDataPolicy.uncertainty: Split-conformal absolute-residual radius at sorted rank ceil((calibrationCount+1)*0.9), one-based; fail if unavailable. Lower=max(0, prediction-radius), upper=prediction+radius. This is a nominal90% modern masked-label interval; exchangeability across eras is not asserted.
missingDataPolicy.thresholdRationale: An integration screen, not a population confidence claim: require a role-informed estimate to outperform the trivial constant, bias below0.25 turnover/36, coverage within5 percentage points of nominal90%, and average interval width at most3 turnover/36 so uncertainty is not hidden in an uninformative range. These engineering tolerances are fixed before measurement.
missingDataPolicy.historicalTreatment: Only if this gate passes: observed peak turnover counts remain observed; predict only missing selected-season rates using that season's observed shots/assists/minutes, pool by minutes with retained observed turnover counts. Separate modeled provenance and lower/central/upper totals, never mutate audit or processed data. Historical league turnover reference and cross-era normalization still require explicit registration in the one strength mapping; no historical coverage claim from modern masking alone.

failureAction: Stop on a failed or unmeasurable stage, retain all evidence and current live balance. Do not try another missing-data policy, change thresholds or add strength mappings without explicit approval. Unused downstream stages do not authorize replacement experiments.
reporting: Record cohort ids, source/writer/protocol hashes, retained donor neighbors, all predictions and intervals, exact gates and unsupported inputs. Exclusive outputs and byte replay required. Existing historical data are exposed; this is not the fresh-family release gate.
